#### G101 `c04-25` R8 F23: No catalog text found by the builder on whether a custom operation rolls back on error; the builder proved it with a test instead (stock of the first line restored when the second line throws a ShopFa

- [ ] **Issue**  Action: [ ] add [x] modify [ ] one-off [ ] ticket [ ] tool [ ] drop
- **Proposed:** modify-catalog → `catalog/agent-docs/backend/custom-operations.md`. custom-operations.md only has test transaction modes (AUTO_ROLLBACK); no runtime rule. Builder proved by test that an exception in a custom operation rolls back all its writes. Add that line (mark verify against the dispatcher).
- **Why:** The backend docs cover rollback for interceptors and for integration test modes (AUTO_ROLLBACK) but not the runtime rule for custom operations; the builder's kb search for the rule found nothing. **Workaround:** Integration-style Playwright test proves the rollback of stock, cart and order.
- **Validation:** confirmed; kind catalog-gap; catalog missing. Evidence: `session:L2380`, `session:L2381`, `session:L2537`, `session:L2539`. add→modify (target file exists; add a section)

#### G102 `c06-12` R11 F44: The CSV export custom operation threw a NullPointerException on input.getFromDate().orElse(...) when the user left the date empty, because the optional input getter returned null, not Optional.empty.

- [ ] **Issue**  Action: [ ] add [x] modify [ ] one-off [ ] ticket [ ] tool [ ] drop
- **Proposed:** modify-catalog → `catalog/agent-docs/backend/custom-operations.md`. custom-operations.md does not say that optional input getters can return null instead of Optional.empty (sweep item BA-042). Add: null-check optional input getters (verify).
- **Why:** Custom operation input getters for optional attributes can return null; the agent-docs custom-operations page does not say this where the builder looked, and the sweep inventory (BA-042) already flagged it. **Workaround:** Null-guarded the getters and the status filter in ExportOrdersCustomImplementation.
- **Validation:** confirmed; kind catalog-gap; catalog missing. Evidence: `session:L3646`, `session:L3647`. add→modify (target file exists; add a section)

#### G114 `c05-04` R9 F29: A 0..1 relation query returns Optional<Product>, while a 1..1 relation query returns the entity; the first build failed with a type mismatch because the builder assumed Optional.

- [ ] **Issue**  Action: [ ] add [x] modify [ ] one-off [ ] ticket [ ] tool [ ] drop
- **Proposed:** modify-catalog → `catalog/agent-docs/backend/data-access-guide.md`. data-access-guide (lines 289-304) says single-valued relation queries return the entity directly; the generated SDK returns Optional<T> for 0..1 (SalesOrderLineDao shows Optional types). Split the rule: 0..1 returns Optional, 1..1 returns the entity.
- **Why:** The kb says single-valued relation queries return the entity but does not separate optional (0..1) from mandatory (1..1) relations. **Workaround:** Used the entity directly for the 1..1 cart line product relation (RemoveProductCustomImplementation.java).
- **Validation:** confirmed; kind catalog-gap; catalog partly-covered. Evidence: `session:L2788`, `session:L2870`, `session:L2871`, `session:L2883`

#### G117 `c06-15` R11 : The 'Ordered' text and history times differed by two hours: the model-built string orderedAtLabel used the platform zone (UTC), while the generated history column rendered in the browser zone (CET).

- [ ] **Issue**  Action: [ ] add [x] modify [ ] one-off [ ] ticket [ ] tool [ ] drop
- **Proposed:** modify-catalog → `catalog/agent-docs/backend/platform-behavior-reference.md`. Time and Time Zones section (line 94) already says model expressions follow defaultZoneId, not the JVM. Add the contrast: generated UI columns render in the browser zone, so model-built strings differ by the zone offset.
- **Why:** Model expressions follow the platform defaultZoneId, the UI follows the browser; the catalog says so but gives no model-side way to show the browser zone. Container is UTC, host CET; default zone already UTC so storage needed no change. **Workaround:** Removed the derived string; see c06-16.
- **Validation:** partly; kind catalog-gap; catalog partly-covered. Evidence: `session:L3236`, `session:L3238`, `session:L3320`, `session:L3321`

## [wrong-fact] Interceptors do not run for SDK/script operations
- src: session:jb-031.json | status: validated | evidence: session 2026-11-06T10-49-13-527Z part 31, subagent explore, runtime__judo-runtime-core/judo-runtime-core-dispatcher/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/runtime/core/dispatcher/DefaultDispatcher.java:716-778
- claim: OperationCallInterceptor Javadoc (:11-17, :26-28): supports behaviour calls, script operations and SDK implementations; empty getOperations means all operation calls are intercepted.
- fact: Interceptors run only for default behaviour operations (Create, Update, Delete, List, Set/Add/Remove/UnsetReference, Refresh, GetTemplate, GetPrincipal, GetUploadToken, Export, ValidateCreate/Update/OperationInput, GetInputRange/GetReferenceRange, GetMetadata). They are called from behaviours/*Call.java via CallInterceptorUtil (20 call sites). Custom (SDK) and script operations are only wrapped in TransactionalOperationCall (DefaultDispatcher.java:716-737, 776-778) and are never intercepted. The Javadoc is wrong and should be fixed.

## [wrong-fact] PayloadImpl hashCode includes __$ keys
- src: session:jb-009.json | status: reported-unvalidated | evidence: session 12:07, subagent C072
- claim: PayloadImpl row and root AGENTS.md:54 say __$ keys excluded from both equals() and hashCode()
- fact: Only equals() excludes them (PayloadImpl.java 141-160); hashCode() at 163-164 returns internal.hashCode(), so equal payloads can have different hash codes. Also put()/putAll() do not wrap nested maps as Payload (getAsPayload() throws on them); only the constructor wraps. dao-api spec covers transient fields for equals only. DAO row omits batch, static-data, default-value, navigation method families.

| B1 | **Custom operation transaction scope** | Whether a custom operation's DAO writes share one transaction, whether they roll back when it throws, partial commits, and what a swallowed DAO error does to the transaction. Only `@JudoTest` transaction modes and interceptor transactions are documented. | bp01, bp02, bp05, bp08, bp12, pb06, pb07 (most-reported gap) |

| B2 | **FileStore Java API** | `FileStoreService` put/get, the generated `FileType` (id, fileName, mimeType) from Java, and `JUDO_PLATFORM_FILESTORE=rdbms`. Only the upload-token REST flow is documented. | bp01, bp05, bp10, pb01, pb03, pb07 |

| B3 | **INITIALIZER operation lifecycle** | Who calls an initializer operation, when (startup or deploy), under which security context, and with which transaction. Docs only say "static, no input". | bp07, pm04, pm06, pb02, pb03 |
| B4 | **Scheduled jobs** | Quartz / OSGi scheduler. What transaction, principal and `ACTOR` variable context a scheduler thread gets. | bp06, bp10, pb05, pb06 |
| B5 | **Email service** | `EmailService` / `EmailMessage` / `BinaryAttachment` API, Handlebars templates, and how the app's mail path uses the SMTP variables. | bp10, pb02, pb03 |

| B6 | **DAO API surface** | Paged `selectList(offset, limit)` / slices, `TimeFilter`, `findAllById` vs `getById`, signatures of the per-relation `create<Rel>` / `add<Rel>` methods, and actor-level DAO packages. | pb01, pb02, pb05, pb06, bp07, bp12 |
| B7 | **DAO and interceptors** | Whether a DAO call from Java service code (for example creating a child) triggers built-in-operation interceptors. | pb05, pb07 |
| B8 | **Unmasked update** | What `update` without a mask does with fields that were not loaded. | pb05 |

| B9 | **Identifier uniqueness** | Whether the `identifier` flag is enforced as unique, for one or several attributes. Docs only say "natural key". Uniqueness appears only as a hand-written validation pattern. | bp01, pm02, pm06, pb07 |
| B10 | **Faults from JCL / script operations** | Whether a script operation can raise a modeled fault or call an OSGi service. | pm04, pb06 |

| B11 | **List-call interceptor payload** | `ListCall.ListCallPayload` and `getQueryCustomizer().getFilter()`. The range payload is partly covered in `interceptors.md`, but there is no worked `_getRangeReference` example that keeps the filter and orderBy and adds constraints. | pb04, bp15 |
| B12 | **Unauthenticated operations** | How to expose an operation without login. The model-level `anonymous` actor flag is documented only in e2e-testing. | bp08, pb05, pb07 |
| B13 | **`isActiveExpression`** | How the runtime evaluates it, and how it interacts with actor resolution by `azp`. There is no sample with a boolean role flag as the guard. | bp14, pm04 |

| B50 | **Actor realm vs schema name** | cciu says `ActorType.realm` must equal the `judo.properties` `schema_name`, otherwise the local-dev Keycloak SSL script times out. Only the `realm` default `DEFAULT` is confirmed (esm.ecore); the script is not in judo-ng. | cciu merge CM-055 |

| B51 | **Transient relations on unmapped TOs** | What `mutable input.<rel>` means for a transient relation; whether an unmapped transient target renders a nested form instead of a picker; that such a relation must be `AGGREGATION` (`ASSOCIATION` fails strict validation; the CLI sets aggregation by default and rejects `aggregation=true` as read-only). | mg1, mg2 |

| B52 | **Access with list cardinality needs a table column** | `validate --strict` fails until the access target's table has a column (`create -t DataColumn --ns <TO>::<TO>_Table --set dataFeature=...`). Not documented. | mg2, also D5 |
